key_difference: (B) still unlinks while the lock is held and only falls back to close-then-unlink on EBUSY/ETXTBSY/EPERM, whereas (D) always closes (dropping the lock) before unlinking and patches the resulting race with an fstat/lstat inode comparison that leaves a TOCTOU window between lstat and unlink and also reports a replaced file as ENOENT ('gone') success.
